decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the 26/12/12.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1201PL(2)02A, 03A, 04B, 05B, 06C, 07B, 08A, 09, 10B, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, Design and Access Statement, Planning Statement received 28/5/12; Amended site plan 1201PL(2)01B received 3/7/12;Perspective drawings received 3/7/12; Amended Plans: 1201 PL (2) 107A, 108, 109,  Received 18/7/12  (P1 approved plans). 
1201 PL (2) 101H,102H,103J,104E, received 17/1/13  (P1NMA),
113B,120E,121D,122A received 21/12/12 (P1NMA),
1201 (PL(2-)105L, 106K,110K, 111G, 112G, 114D, 115B, 116A, PL(2-)152A, 153A,154A,157A  received 7/2/13 (P2)

117 received 8/3/13 (P2)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the
construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Details shall include Alterations to stone and brickwork: areas of new-build will require samples to be agreed; brick panel/s to display bricks and mortar should include the specification and profile of jointing. Metal and panel work: materials to be agreed, and should include information on joints such as seams and their direction where these are visible.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until details, including 1:25 plans, and samples of any
proposed fenestration alterations, have been subitted to and approved in writing by the LPA. Details shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 5 - Public realm (town square) - Prior to the occupation of any part of the development, full
details of the proposed landscaping of the front forecourt of the site will have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include hard and soft landscaping materials, planting plans and maintenance schedules as well as proposed fmished levels or contours; means of enclosure and the boundary treatment to demonstrate connectivity with the adjacent public spaces. The development shall not be occupied until the details have been implemented as approved.

Condition : 6 - Sustainability - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme meeting the requirements of Policy 5.2 of the London Plan which asks for a 25% reduction in regulation C02 emissions below the Part L 2010 TER - through energy efficiency or/and renew abies) where feasible. The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 7 - The A3 use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times -
9am to llpm.
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 9am to 11 pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 9 - The external front podium area and forecourt shall not be used in conjunction with the
hereby approved A3 use outside the following times 9am-9.30pm.

Condition : 10 - The uses hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing
of waste and recycled materials in respect of both the residential and commercial units have
been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for
storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with
any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby
permitted is occupied.

Condition : 11 - The use hereby permitted for A3 purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and
details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the
development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until details of a salvage and reuse strategy has been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include
strategies for the reuse of existing external and internal features which already (or could, with careful repair and refurbishment) add to the character and appearance of the building. Details should include where possible, existing guard railings where they have good design and detail being be re-used or re-sited nearby; any that are not reused should be salvaged not scrapped. External doors and stair railings of original good design and character that exist should be retained and reused even if relocated; Areas where brick or stone is changed should have elements such as keystones and rubbed brick arches retained and reused; or at least salvaged not scrapped.

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until details of the chimney/flue including 1:25 plans and samples of materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission 00607/L/P1 dated  26/10/2012 to incorporate the insertion of revised drawings numbers 1201 PL(2) 105L, 106K, 110K, 111G, 112G and 114D, insertion of new planning drawings numbers 115B and 116A and replacement of existing perspective drawings received 03.07.12 with PL(2) 152, 152, 154 and 157.
